<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Current state: no green blocks
# Try ACTION7 to spawn new green blocks, then click them
# Repeat this cycle to see if level eventually completes

seg = current_frame.segmentation
green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks before ACTION7: {len(green)}")

# ACTION7 to spawn new green blocks
action(['ACTION7'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks after ACTION7: {len(green)}")
for g in green:
    rows = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    print(f"  Click at row={center_row}, col={center_col}")

# Click all green blocks
clicks = []
for g in green:
    rows = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col})

action(clicks)

# Check result
print(f"last_action_result: {last_action_result}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
